source_span: We think the move is a bear-steepener: the front end is anchored by a Fed on hold, so the long end is doing the work as term premium rebuilds... a soft print would not by itself reverse it while the Fed stays on hold.
source_chain: 10-year breaks 4.40% therefore JPM reads it as a bear-steepener because the front end is anchored (Fed on hold) while the long end rises on rebuilding term premium therefore JPM pays 5s30s at 62bp/stop 48bp; invalidation: a hot core PCE print validates the steepener, a soft print alone does NOT reverse it while the Fed stays on hold.
pulse_chain: 10-year breaks 4.40% therefore JPM reads it as markets pricing the next hike, with the front end leading and dragging the long end (a bear-flattener) therefore JPM pays 5s30s at 62bp/stop 48bp; invalidation: Thursday's core PCE decides it, a soft print reverses the trade.
why: The pulse inverts the mechanism (front end leading/bear-flattener vs. the note's long-end-led bear-steepener) and inverts the invalidation (soft PCE reverses the trade vs. the note's explicit 'a soft print would not by itself reverse it').
